verdict.rationale: Data residency or region selection is a fair question for a SaaS payroll/HR platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any customer choice of data storage region or residency. The registered-agent privacy item concerns keeping a mailing address private, and the 50-state compliance item concerns filings; neither is about data location, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
